limits.title: Normal text contrast, including its real ground
limits.rule: Labels, placeholders, code and normal text retain at least 4.5:1 on composed paint in every applicable state. Hover is not a large-text exemption. Keep existing assertion-specific thresholds and no rounding allowance.
limits.enforcement_today: Token gate measures declared opaque pairs across shipped theme/neutral/accent combinations; it explicitly rejects alpha tokens. Syntax and solid-hover pairings are enumerated.
limits.missing_test: Production material compositor gate: alpha + every gradient interior + allowed scene colors/spatial positions, nested paint and actual text pixels/grounds. Token-only success cannot certify glass.

limits.title: Retain supplementary dark APCA floors
limits.rule: Preserve the existing per-pair dark APCA floor in addition to WCAG: body-copy pairs use Lc 75 and content/placeholder/syntax pairs Lc 60 where those constants are assigned. APCA is supplementary Area policy, not WCAG certification.
limits.enforcement_today: Dark-only APCA assertions are executed for each declared token pair; constants and assignments are explicit.
limits.missing_test: Apply those same pair-specific floors to resolved material grounds. Do not claim every glyph or line needs the text APCA floor.

limits.title: Required edges remain independent of decorative strokes
limits.rule: Required control/state boundaries must remain discernible; strong/increased-contrast endpoints retain 3:1. Turning off a material rim or Surface border must not remove required stroke-width paint. Decorative 1.1/1.2/1.3 design floors are not substitutes.
limits.enforcement_today: Token strong-state assertions and compiled-CSS cohesion checks protect roles and required-line ownership. Standard soft presentation has acknowledged shortfalls: this is not evidence that every current boundary passes 3:1.
limits.missing_test: Rendered required-edge checks against both adjacent grounds for each material/state; D7 failing glass edges must use opaque fallback. Do not waive existing soft failures or call identity conformance.

limits.title: Focus survives decoration and simultaneous states
limits.rule: Keep a visible keyboard focus replacement, independent of cast depth; preserve field edge/halo policy, invalid context and selection simultaneously. Test the painted opaque edge, not the source color of a translucent halo. List focus can be a row plate, with forced-colors ring fallback.
limits.enforcement_today: Focus token pair assertions exist; CSS restores Menu focus in forced colors. Cohesion checks the normal row highlight plate, not its rendered contrast.
limits.missing_test: Real keyboard traversal with focused+selected, focused+invalid, clipping, top-layer and glass/glow backgrounds; pixel/contrast tests for the actual outline and both sides. Static CSS assertions do not prove visibility.

limits.title: Foreground stays fixed on hover
limits.rule: Material hover may alter backing, highlight, edge or depth, but must not change foreground ink or fade the content as a workaround. A genuinely revealed control is distinct from dimming an existing label.
limits.enforcement_today: The compiled-CSS lexical check rejects hover/highlight color/opacity changes except documented inheritance/system-color/reveal cases.
limits.missing_test: Computed color, fill, stroke, opacity and ancestor filter checks through actual hover, including aliases and Material gate selectors. A lexical color check does not catch parent filters or variable rewrites.

limits.title: Semantic meaning and required state paint are retained
limits.rule: Action/selection and tone continue to own semantic backing/ink. Selected, checked, invalid, progress and literal color data remain truthful; meaningful marks have positioned geometry and non-color/native/ARIA cues. Required plate/mark paint is not scaled by decorative strength.
limits.enforcement_today: Action-versus-selection CSS tests, row selection precedence and markup assertions for checked/disabled/loading exist.
limits.missing_test: All materials × role/state integration tests including quantitative fill extents, simultaneous states, contrast and screen-reader output. Material-specific masking must not erase a mark.

limits.title: Behavior, naming and targets survive optical layers
limits.rule: Keep native props, accessible names, focus order, keyboard/pointer operation, hit targets and overlay relationships. Decorative overlays must not intercept events, obscure required content, alter scroll or break portal positioning.
limits.enforcement_today: Existing component tests cover representative ARIA markup and overlay positioning. Theme defines a complete React attribute boundary, including portals.
limits.missing_test: Material-on versus baseline real-event and accessibility-tree comparisons, RTL/touch/zoom, screen-reader and native forced-colors execution. SSR tests are partial enforcement.

limits.title: Disabled, read-only and loading remain distinct
limits.rule: Do not double-apply disabled opacity or fade an already disabled group again. Preserve fields that use disabled color rather than group opacity; loading keeps its existing focus/Stop semantics.
limits.enforcement_today: Cohesion protects disabled field paint; audit tests protect native-disabled versus loading and read-only field paint.
limits.missing_test: Composed alpha checks on disabled parent+child+material, and state interaction tests for every role. Disabled exemptions do not authorize invisible required context.

limits.title: Contrast preferences and local scopes keep working
limits.rule: Honor increased contrast, explicit local standard reset and root OS preference rules. Re-derive colors at each axis/preference boundary; nested Material must not bake parent contrast or theme into a child.
limits.enforcement_today: Emitter tests assert contrast preference selectors and re-emission, plus non-registration of derived edge/fill/token colors.
limits.missing_test: Actual nested Material × contrast × light/dark tests including portals, mode flips and raw DOM scopes. Extend rather than replace current emitter tests.

limits.title: Unknown backdrops require composition and a safe fallback
limits.rule: D7: floating shells assume any backdrop; required edges that fail use an opaque fallback. Test all allowed backdrop colors/positions and gradient interiors, not only black/white endpoints. A bounded gray ramp is not the whole RGB/image domain.
limits.enforcement_today: Binding owner rule; current production token gate explicitly cannot composite alpha. Task 18 is a research prototype on old seeds, not a shipping material test.
limits.missing_test: Production worst-case sampler matched to interpolation/color space, image/spatial adversaries and fallback validation on real receivers. For unbounded or unproved scenes, resolve to the opaque safety path rather than infer a pass from samples.

limits.title: Transparency reduction is both app-level and OS-driven
limits.rule: D7 requires an app-level setting beside the OS query. Reduction disables material acquisition/transmission and supplies an opaque readable ground while retaining semantic state and focus. An unavailable query is not evidence the user permits transparency.
limits.enforcement_today: Owner rule only for the new material layer. The source search below finds no production prefers-reduced-transparency hook or Material setting.
limits.missing_test: Preference resolution, app override plus OS reduction, unsupported-query engines, nested scopes, portals, and no-alpha/no-backdrop-filter assertions under reduction. API naming and precedence details belong to the later design/safety tasks.

limits.title: Forced colors supplies opaque functional paint
limits.rule: D7: explicitly opaque Canvas and backdrop-filter:none, including the prefixed path where used; remove material gradient/grain/filter overlays and preserve system focus, marks, selection and invalid indication. A broad forced-color-adjust:none is not a fallback.
limits.enforcement_today: Current forced-colors stylesheet supplies system edges, outlines, native Select arrow, marks and selected rows. It does not supply a general material opacity/backdrop-filter reset.
limits.missing_test: Native Windows forced-colors plus browser preference tests of every new optical layer: inspect alpha, pseudo-elements, filters and functional markers. Do not rely on automatic forced colors to remove background alpha or backdrop filtering.

limits.title: Motion preferences retain meaning without unnecessary motion
limits.rule: OS reduced motion must override local motion scopes and stop decorative loops; loading/progress still communicates its state. Never delay focus for an animation. None also preserves current normal-motion behavior.
limits.enforcement_today: Emitter re-emits motion-none for root and motion scopes under the media query; MOTION documents stopped loops and immediate keyboard focus.
limits.missing_test: New material light/gloss/refraction/grain animation preference tests, interrupted transitions and settled geometry. Existing duration generation is not a test of every new animation.

limits.title: No automatic decoration of glyphs or small text
limits.rule: D13 prohibits automatic inherited glyph/small-text effects. Display text and button labels may explicitly opt in; duotone remains a separate later pilot. Opt-in does not relax contrast, geometry or foreground ownership.
limits.enforcement_today: Owner rule, with current plain Field label/semantic ink CSS as baseline. No production opt-in Material gate is present.
limits.missing_test: Automatic-host effect leakage tests, 12–16px legibility review and opt-in scope tests. A whole-parent filter also decorates descendants and must be detected.

limits.title: Geometry, typography and ink belong to their existing axes
limits.rule: D16: a material changes optical surface paint, not dimensions, layout, radius, stroke geometry, glyph drawings, type metrics or semantic foreground values. Separate geometry/type/ink settings may be bundled with material, but the bundle is not the Material axis. Required focus geometry survives.
limits.enforcement_today: Owner rule; component contract/geometry CSS and manifest parity enforce baseline structures, not equivalence under an absent new axis.
limits.missing_test: Material-on/off computed rects, box model, font metrics, wrapping, SVG geometry, content ink, targets and overflow comparisons. Additional optical extents may change; use them without changing layout or hiding content.

limits.title: Disjoint token ownership, local derivation and canonical colors
limits.rule: Keep axis namespaces disjoint and palette values verbatim. Derive interactions in base and re-emit at boundaries; never register derived/paired semantic colors. D2 requires Material beside Surface and inherited recipe gates, with pixel-identical Surface decomposition first.
limits.enforcement_today: Registry tests catch duplicate ownership/namespace errors; color tests protect polarity, paired registrations and selected derived outputs. D2 migration itself has not shipped.
limits.missing_test: New Material namespace/gate/reset tests and emitter-wide single-writer checks, full derived-color registration coverage and None identity tests through the Surface migration.

limits.title: Decorative colors derive from the theme
limits.rule: D5: derive decorative colors from accent, neutral and tones rather than hardcoded preset hex palettes; do not recolor semantic data or change foreground ink.
limits.enforcement_today: Owner rule; current Action/Selection tests enforce representative semantic consumers, not every future gradient stop.
limits.missing_test: Recipe-schema/source validation forbidding literal decorative palettes plus accent/neutral/tonal switching tests across all material outputs.

limits.title: Near-black page stays within an explicitly bounded distance
limits.rule: D10 permits page tint/texture only within a fixed distance of neutral 975 / #020202. This is a constraint requiring calibration, not permission for an arbitrary dark material background.
limits.enforcement_today: Owner rule; base body consumes bg-page. No agreed distance metric or numeric bound is present in the review.
limits.missing_test: Owner/calibration definition of the bound, then resolved-page pixel/color checks at control extremes and texture peaks. Do not invent a Delta-E or alpha threshold in this task.

limits.title: Inner rims obey the radius floor
limits.rule: D11 applies the radius floor to inner rims at every setting except Sharp. D16 keeps the actual receiver shape from its geometry axis; Material may not square an inner rim by blindly clamping radius minus inset at zero.
limits.enforcement_today: Owner rule; current Card radius and media radius explicitly use radius-floor.
limits.missing_test: Every generated material rim × radius/density/size, including Sharp and pill, needs geometry tests; current Card CSS alone is not a global optical-rim proof.

limits.title: Cutout rings and fixed-color fades use real gaps
limits.rule: D12 requires masks for cutout rings and fixed-color fades when adapting them to materials. A page-colored imitation cannot reveal the real host. Preserve separately necessary occlusion, focus and status marks. None must retain baseline pixels while this migration is introduced.
limits.enforcement_today: Owner rule only for the general material-aware gap conversion; current required-stroke checks guard related lines, not actual alpha transmission.
limits.missing_test: Arbitrary host/backdrop and nested None/material mask tests, including Card/Code fades and Avatar/Indicator/Presence gaps; verify both pixel identity on original plain grounds and truthful transmission on material hosts.

limits.title: Unsupported optics never remove the usable fallback
limits.rule: D8 defines frost plus rim now and SVG refraction only as a later Chromium enhancement. Unsupported filter paths must still satisfy hard limits and D7 opaque fallback when contrast cannot be established.
limits.enforcement_today: Binding review; production Material/refraction path not found in the surveyed package sources.
limits.missing_test: Feature/path fallback tests in target engines, plus app-level reduction and forced colors. A generic backdrop-filter supports test is not proof of SVG URL displacement.

limits.title: Validation is additive and claims match evidence
limits.rule: Do not lower floors, add a waiver to hide a failure, discard inconvenient scenes or weaken existing checks. D14 measured performance rules need an owner-named 60Hz minimum device, not invented universal blur/lobe bans. Passing identity/builds never means owner approval.
limits.enforcement_today: Contrast report exits nonzero on unwaived failures; exceptions list is empty. Negative contrast test proves a bad foreground fails. Review binds performance and approval remains owner-set.
limits.missing_test: Material adversarial negative controls, image/AT/cross-engine coverage and the named-device benchmark. No justified universal performance cap is available yet.
